name: kinsy
description: Finished, editable PowerPoint decks from a brief and your documents: Kinsy's remote MCP server (create, wait, download, edit) plus the kinsy skill for the CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Finished, editable PowerPoint decks from a brief and your documents.
interface.longDescription: Kinsy turns a brief and your source documents into a native PowerPoint file: real text boxes, tables and charts, embedded fonts and a slide master, with unsupported numbers flagged. Ask for a deck and paste or attach your notes, report or data; Kinsy returns a download link and a web link to review and edit every slide. A finished deck takes one to two minutes. Change one slide with a single instruction, pick a visual theme, or save the deck to Google Slides in your own Drive. For coding agents, the kinsy skill teaches the same job through the Kinsy CLI. Limitations: Kinsy builds new decks and edits its own; it does not edit a .pptx you already have. Decks are stored in your Kinsy account until you delete them.
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-slide board update from my notes
Turn this report into a pitch deck
Put that deck in my Google Drive as Google Slides

positive.description: Build a deck from a pasted brief
positive.prompt: Make a 10-slide deck on the history of chocolate for a general audience: origins, the industrial era, today's market, and two surprising facts.
positive.expected_behavior: create_deck returns a deck_id at once; wait_for_deck reports progress and then the .pptx download link and the kinsy.ai review link.

positive.description: Build a deck from attached source material
positive.prompt: Here are our Q3 metrics (pasted CSV). Make a board update: revenue and churn against plan, the Q4 hiring plan, and two asks for the board.
positive.expected_behavior: The pasted data is passed as a source; the finished deck uses only figures the source supports and flags any it cannot.

positive.description: Check on a deck without waiting
positive.prompt: What is the status of deck deck-70a130?
positive.expected_behavior: get_deck reports the status (building or done) and, when done, a download link and the review link.

positive.prompt: On slide 3 of that deck, tighten the headline and cut the bullets to three.
positive.expected_behavior: edit_slide rewrites slide 3 and returns the updated deck links; nothing else on the deck changes.

positive.prompt: Which looks can Kinsy give the deck?
positive.expected_behavior: list_themes returns the theme names and a one-line description of each.

negative.description: Editing a file the user already has
negative.prompt: Fix the typos in the attached quarterly-review.pptx.

negative.description: A request with nothing to do with slides
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Singapore this weekend?

negative.description: Asking the plugin to buy credits
negative.prompt: Buy 500 Kinsy credits on my card.
